examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The first-reply SLA of a ticket in its three states: time left, warning when under an hour is left, and overdue once the deadline has passed. Each state changes the icon and the words as well as the colour.

examples.name: Paused
examples.summary: A paused resolution SLA next to a running first-reply SLA, as a ticket header shows them while the ticket waits on the customer.

examples.name: Expiry
examples.summary: `type="expiry"` for a certificate, an API key with a two-day warning window and a trial that ended yesterday.
